_use_when: One or two numbers the person supplied are strong enough to carry an image and no real artifact exists. Every {PLACEHOLDER} must come from the person's source; never fill one with an example value.

output.mobile_read: The main number and its label must read without opening the image.

main_visual.description: A plain before and after card: {METRIC LABEL} moving from {BEFORE VALUE} to {AFTER VALUE} over {TIME PERIOD}.

colors: Saved brand colors, if any; otherwise one dark ink color on off white.
